bio: The Frierss family are renowned for their sausages and other meat products. These wares are on site in their butcher's shop and well-stocked delicatessen, and are also to be found on the menu in this modern restaurant. Barbecued steaks feature among the mouth-watering specialities of the house, but there are fish and vegetarian options prepared in the open kitchen. Good selection of wines. A budget-friendly lunch deal is available, too. The staff are incredibly dedicated and friendly. Tip: You can also have breakfast here....
